intro: Reson brings structure to life’s little messes. Asymmetric, open, and thoughtfully sized—it helps you live better, not just neater.

features.title: We built this top to last
features.text: The 18mm PLT board top offers durability you can count on—resisting everyday wear while keeping a clean, polished look.

features.title: A palette that balances beautifully
features.text: The dual-tone brown and black finish adds quiet contrast—striking the perfect blend of warmth and modern edge.

features.title: Storage that plays by its own rules
features.text: With asymmetric open shelves, you can stack, style, or stow your essentials in a layout that’s all your own.

features.title: Lines that give it strength and style
features.text: Metal vertical supports not only strengthen the table—they add an industrial design edge that grounds the whole piece.

features.title: Small in size, bold in feel
features.text: Reson’s compact frame fits tighter spaces with ease—while still making a stylish statement in any setting.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
